notes.title: Pushmania - update 1.0.10 - overall stability and QoL additions
notes.notes:
Hi! 
Thanks for the warm welcome to Pushmania, we appreciate every review and every comment.
We have released a new update 1.0.10, which focuses on both bug fixes and improving the overall experience, enhanced controls, and UI.

Selected features:
[list]
[*] in story mode, the number of barriers that can be unlocked is now displayed, the notification icon also appears directly in the MENU
[*] added UI icons when multiple controllers are connected
[*] added a progress bar for the REPLAY function
[*] added a virtual keyboard in Japanese
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349738/6967ab60c49f7554098535d91f80f7033f5e8763.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349738/2159b988950417d13eb4adaa15665de3ab0c9cec.png[/img]

Pushmania in the media:
[list]
[*] the first reviews are a success with 4 out of 5 (LEVEL) and 8 out of 10 (Doupě.cz)
[*] we were on national television with the game as part of a children's program
[*] a review and a printed poster were published in a local gaming magazine
[*] we participated in several (video) podcasts of Czech gaming media
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349738/ffa0182851026155bbe42ff7ceee0d66ee0de26a.png[/img]

Thank you for whishlisting, trying the DEMO and buying the game.
Franta & Zdenek

notes.title: Pushmania Release Date: 18. 4. 2025
notes.notes:
Dear all, 
a homage loveletter to digital games, our game about two brothers made by two brothers, in which puzzle sokoban meets digital game culture of our past, will be released on 18th of April 2025.

The game has: 300 maps, a full story, a complete soundtrack, leaderboards, a fully functional custom map editor and maybe even a little bit of doom and prince of persia and ... (?!).

Thank you all for whishlisting, trying the DEMO and buying the game!

Franta&Zdenek
